lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੯ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohee mahalaa 1 ghar 9 ||
lines.translation: Soohee, First Mehl, Ninth House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਚਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਕਾ ਥੋੜੜਿਆ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kachaa ra(n)g kasu(n)bh kaa thoRaRiaa din chaar jeeu ||
lines.translation: The color of safflower is transitory; it lasts for only a few days.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੀਆ ਠਗਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: vin naavai bhram bhuleeaa thag muthee kooRiaar jeeu ||
lines.translation: Without the Name, the false woman is deluded by doubt and plundered by thieves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਵਾਰ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sache setee ratiaa janam na doojee vaar jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: But those who are attuned to the True Lord, are not reincarnated again. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੰਗੇ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਰੰਗੀਐ ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ra(n)ge kaa kiaa ra(n)geeai jo rate ra(n)g laai jeeu ||
lines.translation: How can one who is already dyed in the color of the Lord's Love, be colored any other color?

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੰਗਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ra(n)gan vaalaa seveeai sache siu chit laai jeeu ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: So serve God the Dyer, and focus your consciousness on the True Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਜੇ ਭਵਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaare ku(n)daa je bhavahi bin bhaagaa dhan naahi jeeu ||
lines.translation: You wander around in the four directions, but without the good fortune of destiny, you shall never obtain wealth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਗਣਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਜੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਬਧਿਕ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: avagan muthee je phirahi badhik thaai na paahi jeeu ||
lines.translation: If you are plundered by corruption and vice, you shall wander around, but like a fugitive, you shall find no place of rest.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur raakhe se ubare sabad rate man maahi jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: Only those who are protected by the Guru are saved; their minds are attuned to the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਿਟੇ ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਕਪੜੇ ਮੈਲੇ ਚਿਤ ਕਠੋਰ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: chite jin ke kapaRe maile chit kathor jeeu ||
lines.translation: Those who wear white clothes, but have filthy and stone-hearted minds,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਚੋਰ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin mukh naam na oopajai doojai viaape chor jeeu ||
lines.translation: may chant the Lord's Name with their mouths, but they are engrossed in duality; they are thieves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੂਲੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੇ ਪਸੂਆ ਸੇ ਢੋਰ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: mool na boojhahi aapanaa se pasooaa se dhor jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: They do not understand their own roots; they are beasts. They are just animals! ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਮੰਗੈ ਸੁਖ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: nit nit khuseeaa man kare nit nit ma(n)gai sukh jeeu ||
lines.translation: Constantly, continually, the mortal seeks pleasures. Constantly, continually, he begs for peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਤਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਲਗਹਿ ਦੁਖ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: karataa chit na aavaee phir phir lagahi dukh jeeu ||
lines.translation: But he does not think of the Creator Lord, and so he is overtaken by pain, again and again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਕੈਸੀ ਭੁਖ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: sukh dukh daataa man vasai tit tan kaisee bhukh jeeu ||4||
lines.translation: But one, within whose mind the Giver of pleasure and pain dwells - how can his body feel any need? ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਕੀ ਵਾਲਾ ਤਲਬੀਐ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: baakee vaalaa talabeeai sir maare ja(n)daar jeeu ||
lines.translation: One who has a karmic debt to pay off is summoned, and the Messenger of Death smashes his head.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੈ ਦੇਵਣਾ ਪੁਛੈ ਕਰਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: lekhaa ma(n)gai devanaa puchhai kar beechaar jeeu ||
lines.translation: When his account is called for, it has to be given. After it is reviewed, payment is demanded.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਲਿਵ ਉਬਰੈ ਬਖਸੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: sache kee liv ubarai bakhase bakhasanahaar jeeu ||5||
lines.translation: Only love for the True One will save you; the Forgiver forgives. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨ ਕੋ ਕੀਜੈ ਮਿਤੜਾ ਖਾਕੁ ਰਲੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: an ko keejai mitaRaa khaak ralai mar jaai jeeu ||
lines.translation: If you make any friend other than God, you shall die and mingle with the dust.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਭੁਲਿ ਭੁਲਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahu ra(n)g dekh bhulaaiaa bhul bhul aavai jaai jeeu ||
lines.translation: Gazing upon the many games of love, you are beguiled and bewildered; you come and go in reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਨਦਰੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: nadar prabhoo te chhuteeai nadaree mel milaai jeeu ||6||
lines.translation: Only by God's Grace can you be saved. By His Grace, He unites in His Union. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਫਲ ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਭਾਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaaphal giaan vihooniaa gur bin giaan na bhaal jeeu ||
lines.translation: O careless one, you are totally lacking any wisdom; do not seek wisdom without the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿੰਚੋਤਾਣਿ ਵਿਗੁਚੀਐ ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਦੁਇ ਨਾਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: khi(n)chotaan vigucheeai buraa bhalaa dui naal jeeu ||
lines.translation: By indecision and inner conflict, you shall come to ruin. Good and bad both pull at you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਭੈ ਰਤਿਆ ਸਭ ਜੋਹੀ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: bin sabadai bhai ratiaa sabh johee jamakaal jeeu ||7||
lines.translation: Without being attuned to the Word of the Shabad and the Fear of God, all come under the gaze of the Messenger of Death. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਧਾਰਿਆ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇਇ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kar kaaran dhaariaa sabhasai dei aadhaar jeeu ||
lines.translation: He who created the creation and sustains it, gives sustenance to all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: so kiu manahu visaareeai sadaa sadaa daataar jeeu ||
lines.translation: How can you forget Him from your mind? He is the Great Giver, forever and ever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਨਿਧਾਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੮॥੧॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam na veesarai nidhaaraa aadhaar jeeu ||8||1||2||
lines.translation: Nanak shall never forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Support of the unsupported. ||8||1||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਕਾਫੀ ਘਰੁ ੧੦ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohee mahalaa 1 kaaphee ghar 10 ||
lines.translation: Soohee, First Mehl, Kaafee, Tenth House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੁਲੰਭੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: maanas janam dula(n)bh guramukh paaiaa ||
lines.translation: For if you depart with virtue, then pain shall never afflict you. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਚੁਲੰਭੁ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: man tan hoi chula(n)bh je satigur bhaaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: The mind and body are dyed in the deep red color of devotional love, if it pleases the True Guru. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਲੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਵਖਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਲੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: chalai janam savaar vakhar sach lai ||
lines.translation: He departs with his life embellished and successful, taking the merchandise of the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਭੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: pat paae darabaar satigur sabad bhai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He is honored in the Darbaar, the Royal Court, of the Lord, through the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru, and the Fear of God. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan sach salaahi saache man bhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: One who praises the True Lord with his mind and body, pleases the Mind of the True Lord.
